SELECT schedule_num, team_num, user_num, title, content, category, color,
TO_CHAR( start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS start_date,
TO_CHAR( end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS end_date,
all_day, status, reg_date, modify_date
FROM SCHEDULE
WHERE schedule_num = #{schedule_num} AND status = 1

SELECT schedule_num, team_num, user_num, title, content, category, color,
TO_CHAR( start_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS start_date,
TO_CHAR( end_date, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI' ) AS end_date,
all_day, status, reg_date, modify_date
FROM SCHEDULE
WHERE team_num = #{team_num} AND status = 1
ORDER BY start_date DESC, schedule_num DESC
